narrative: Azalee Maggio, 84, is on a diabetes-driven nephropathy course.
Obesity and prediabetes in early adulthood progressed through metabolic syndrome to full Type 2 diabetes by 63, with kidney function declining in step to CKD Stage 3 by 79.
Managed on an 11-drug regimen: insulin and metformin for glucose, a four-drug cardiac/BP stack, a statin, and an inhaler for chronic obstructive bronchitis.
Also carries anemia, sleep apnea, and hypertriglyceridemia as active, unresolved conditions.
